goal:
I'm checking last winter's weather in Berlin with the Open-Meteo historical weather API: https://archive-api.open-meteo.com/v1/archive?latitude=52.52&longitude=13.41&start_date=2024-01-15&end_date=2024-01-15&daily=temperature_2m_max&timezone=Europe%2FBerlin
What was the maximum temperature (2 m) in Berlin (52.52 N, 13.41 E) on 15 January 2024? Please tell me where you found it.
